text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第1批 · 06 · 玻璃穹顶下的候车厅.
Environment: A richly observed film set with a specific emotional story, original architecture and arrangement, not a replica of a film frame. Vicky aesthetic: luminous high-key exposure with retained highlight detail, cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown, restrained pastel accents, broad soft daylight, filled low shadows, fine natural material texture and wear, very subtle film halation and grain, elegant believable photographic realism. Eye-level natural 50mm perspective, layered foreground/midground/background, gentle depth separation but environment clearly readable. Space reserved at central lower midground for future character compositing. ABSOLUTELY EMPTY ENVIRONMENT: no people, no characters, no animals, birds or insects, no human silhouettes, no human reflections, no hands, no faces on paintings, posters or screens, no statues or mannequins. No logos, watermarks, readable text. Avoid CGI real-estate renders, sterile showrooms, excessive bloom, orange grading, deep black shadows, ultrawide distortion. Scene: original 1930s European railway station side concourse before opening, photograph of a real period film set. High milk-glass barrel-vault roof and pale gray iron arches, creamy stone walls, a large simple analog clock centered above a passage at rear (no written lettering), warm brown wooden waiting benches along left wall, a closed wooden ticket kiosk on right, a small tan suitcase beside the nearest bench. A partial foreground arch frames the view. The floor is pale worn limestone, soft daylight pools gently with low shadows, corridor leads toward bright hazy platforms without any train occupants or pedestrians. Keep central floor clear. Research inspiration: Hugo's crafted railway architecture and clock motif; remake as luminous pale cream and warm wood, intimate lower concourse scale, no turquoise-orange night look, no steampunk clutter. Emotion: departure, reunion, a hidden letter.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第1批 · 06 · 玻璃穹顶下的候车厅. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
